name: Primal Panic
summary: Primal Panic  is a Virtual reality horror game inspired by the fan favorite Gorilla Tag locomotion. In primal panic you are in a facility and a bunch of other maps. The goal of Primal Panic is to run and stay away from monsters. You can also go to Primal Panic to make friends. Primal Panic will always be getting active updates. And high-quality updates. Game Developed by BorisGames.
